brief:
Israel launched six artillery shells Saturday evening on the outskirts of Rafid village in southern Quneitra province, southwestern Syria, Shehab Wire reported. The barrage struck an area in the southern countryside of Quneitra, a region that borders the Israeli-occupied Golan Heights and has faced recurring cross-border military operations in recent years.

Syrian state television documented the strikes but provided no immediate account of casualties or structural damage from the bombardment. The incident marks another in a series of Israeli military actions targeting areas near the demilitarized zone separating Israeli and Syrian territory.
